question: With which set of five ritual items should Mahākāla be worshipped?
premises: Five apacoras are specified as instruments.
Worship is prescribed by the optative.
These items accompany the worship of Mahākāla.
inference: One should worship Mahākāla with the five apacoras.
uncertainties: The exact identity of the five apacoras is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: One should worship him with the five apacoras.
